text:
Priya: quick async standup — small one today. What I did: finished the initial eval sweep for synthia3-smallq (50 prompts), pushed metrics to the eval dashboard.
Alex: nice. any red flags?
Priya: overall latency/p50 looks fine but saw a spike in token allocs for a specific prompt group (legal-contracts). p95 jumped ~80ms after kv warmup regen.
Sam: can you paste the exact command you used to run the sweep?
Priya: sure — `./tools/run_eval --model synthia3-smallq --promptset contract-snippets --batch 8 --kv-warmup true --out s3://redwood-evals/priya/5389`
Nina: hmm, that `--kv-warmup true` might be exposing regen jitter. did you try `--batch 4`? smaller batches often flatten p95 on the smaller GPU pool.
Priya: not yet. doing a follow-up run with batch 4 now. also opening a quick PR with a prompt fix (trim stop tokens) — PR #6123.
Alex: pinged you on the PR, left one nit about tests. can we land quickly so Dedicated CI can re-run?
Priya: yep I'll address the test flake tonight.
Sam: blocker for me: I started a canary rollout of synthia3-smallq to the dev route but the routing rules didn't account for fallback to quantized variant. seeing 502s when capacity hits.
Priya: @Sam did you check the model-compatible-variants list in the rollout config? might be missing `synthia3-smallq-quant`.
Sam: good call — I did not. adding it now.
deploy-bot: deploy queued: rollout synthia3-smallq v1.3 -> dev (canary 10%), started at 2025-03-14T14:12:10Z.
Nina: small FYI — promptset drift alert fired on the Spanish-billing set this morning. false positives mostly but a cluster of hallucinations on invoice-date parsing.
Priya: thanks — I'll add those examples to the regression hotlist and include them in the next eval sweep.
Alex: logistics: I'm OOO tomorrow morning; Sam will own the dev route rollback if needed.
Sam: noted. I can watch the canary dashboard and trigger rollbacks. set alert to pager if p50 > 150ms or error-rate > 1%.
Priya: for today's plan: finish batch-4 eval, push updated metrics, update PR #6123 tests, and add the 8 regression examples to the hotlist.
Nina: I'll triage the Spanish examples and create a small prompt patch we can test in a shadow run.
Sam: quick code-review ping for Alex: PR #6109 (kv-cache eviction tweak). low risk, 1 small comment left.
Alex: reviewing after lunch, should be quick.
Priya: thanks team. tagging @Sam for the rollback playbook link: https://internal.redwood/playbooks/rollback (copied below in case).
Priya: ```
# rollback checklist
1) switch route to fallback model variant
2) cancel in-flight canary increments
3) scale up fallback pool if needed
4) notify oncall + update slack thread
```
Alex: :thumbsup: keep updates here. will check back later.
Sam: monitoring the canary, will post any anomalies here. :eyes:
Nina: will post the Spanish prompt patch once ready.
Priya: last note — leaving a short smoke note in the eval dashboard: tag `synthia3-2025-03-14-pri` so we can filter quickly.
Sam: acknowledged.
Priya: end.
